persona.bio: Brian Kowalczyk maintains telescopes and equipment at an observatory near Flagstaff. He also gives public tours on weekends, explaining what astronomers are discovering about exoplanets, black holes, and the early universe. He spends his clear nights taking astrophotography and his cloudy nights processing images and reading arxiv papers.
